description: The agent-native LLM router for autonomous agents. Every frontier model behind one wallet, <1ms local routing, USDC payments on Base & Solana via x402.
readme_summary: Route every request to the right model at the right price. 15-dimension scoring, One wallet, 30+ models, zero API keys. Done! Smart routing (`blockrun/auto`) is now your default model. **Shortcuts:** `/model grok`, `/model br-sonnet`, `/model gpt5`, `/model o3` **100% local routing. <1ms latency. Zero external API calls.** **Blended average: $2.05/M** vs $25/M for Claude Opus = **92% savings** > **Free tier:** `gpt-oss-120b` costs nothing and serves as automatic fallback when wallet is empty. **The flow:** 1. **Wallet auto-generated** on Base (L2) — saved at `~/.openclaw/blockrun/wallet.key` 2. **Fund with $1 USDC** — enough for hundreds of requests 3. **Request any model** — ClawRouter picks the cheapest capable one 4. **Pay per request** — non-custodial, you hold your keys
